title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Account Agreement — One Payout Account per Shopper
content:
## Clause 1 — Number of payout accounts

1.1 Under Cartwise Shopper Payouts a shopper holds one payout account. The limit is 1 payout account per shopper contractor account.

1.2 Moving between payout plans (for example from Weekly Direct Deposit to Instant Cashout, or between the Everyday Pay Card plans) is a plan change on that same payout account. It is never the opening of a second payout account.

1.3 A new payout account can be opened only when the shopper has no payout account that is not closed.

## Clause 2 — What the records must show

2.1 Whether a new payout account may be opened is decided from the payout account records held for the shopper's contractor account, as they stand before the opening. The shopper's own statement that an earlier account "was stopped" or "is no longer used" does not decide it.

2.2 An existing payout account counts against the limit while it is in any status other than closed, that is while it is pending verification, active or frozen. Only a payout account in the closed status leaves room for a new one.

2.3 The comparison is made on the same shopper contractor account: payout accounts belonging to another shopper's contractor account are not counted.

## Schedule — Status of the existing account and the result

| Existing payout account on the same contractor account | May a new payout account be opened? |
|---|---|
| None on record | Yes |
| One, status closed | Yes |
| One, status pending verification | No |
| One, status active | No |
| One, status frozen | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A shopper whose only payout account closed after verification failed has no payout account that is not closed; a new payout account may be opened.
- A shopper whose payout account is frozen and who asks to "start over" with a new account still holds a payout account that is not closed; no new payout account is opened. A move to another plan, where one is sought, is a plan change on the existing account.
